title: Japanese Ukiyo-e
description: Woodblock prints of the 'floating world' — landscapes, kabuki, and everyday Edo life.

items.title: Under the Wave off Kanagawa (Kanagawa oki nami ura), also known as The Great Wave, from the series "Thirty-Six Views of Mount Fuji (Fugaku sanjūrokkei)"
items.description_narrative: Katsushika Hokusai's iconic color woodblock print, 'The Great Wave,' captures a colossal wave cresting over three fishing boats, threatening to engulf them amidst a turbulent sea. In the distance, the serene form of Mount Fuji stands against the sky, anchoring this dramatic scene from his famous series 'Thirty-Six Views of Mount Fuji.'
items.tags: great wave, mount fuji, ukiyo-e, woodblock print, ocean, dramatic, japanese landscape

items.title: Cranes on snow-covered pine
items.description_narrative: This color woodblock print by Katsushika Hokusai depicts elegant cranes resting amidst a snow-covered pine tree. The composition masterfully captures the serenity and stark beauty of nature in winter.
items.tags: cranes, snow, pine, nature, woodblock print, ukiyo-e, serene

items.title: Shower Below the Summit (Sanka hakuu), from the series "Thirty-Six Views of Mount Fuji (Fugaku sanjurokkei)"
items.description_narrative: In 'Shower Below the Summit,' a striking landscape from Hokusai's renowned series, a dramatic storm unfolds beneath Mount Fuji's peak. Dark clouds obscure the sacred mountain, highlighted by a sudden flash of lightning, capturing nature's fleeting power.
items.tags: japanese art, ukiyo-e, landscape, woodblock print, mount fuji, storm, nature, edo period

items.title: Under the Wave off Kanagawa (Kanagawa oki nami ura), also known as The Great Wave, from the series "Thirty-Six Views of Mount Fuji (Fugaku sanjurokkei)"
items.description_narrative: A monumental wave dominates this scene, poised to engulf fishing boats near Kanagawa, with Mount Fuji visible in the distance. This iconic work is part of Hokusai's renowned series "Thirty-Six Views of Mount Fuji," capturing both nature's power and human vulnerability.
items.tags: wave, seascape, mount fuji, ukiyo-e, woodblock print, japanese art, dramatic, nature

items.title: Hara, from the series ""Fifty-three Stations of the Tokaido (Tokaido gojusan tsugi)""
items.description_narrative: Katsushika Hokusai's 'Hara' is a vibrant color woodblock print from his renowned series 'Fifty-three Stations of the Tokaido'. This work captures a specific stop along the historic travel route, offering a glimpse into the landscapes and daily life of Edo-period Japan.
items.tags: woodblock print, ukiyo-e, landscape, travel, Edo period, Japan, series, scenic

items.title: Odawara, from the series "Fifty-three Stations of the Tokaido (Tokaido gojusan tsugi)"
items.description_narrative: This color woodblock print by Katsushika Hokusai depicts Odawara, a stop from his celebrated series "Fifty-three Stations of the Tokaido." As a chuban print, it showcases the artist's mastery of the ukiyo-e style in depicting landscapes and travel scenes.
items.tags: japanese art, ukiyo-e, landscape, woodblock print, tokaido, travel, historical, scenic

items.title: Sakanoshita, from the series "Fifty-three Stations of the Tokaido (Tokaido gojusan tsugi)"

items.title: Kohada Koheiji, from the series "One Hundred Ghost Tales (Hyaku monogatari)"
items.description_narrative: This haunting color woodblock print depicts the ghost of Kohada Koheiji, a character from a Japanese kaidan (ghost story), rising from the water. Created by Katsushika Hokusai, it is part of his celebrated series, 'One Hundred Ghost Tales,' showcasing his mastery of supernatural themes.
items.tags: japanese art, ukiyo-e, woodblock print, ghost, supernatural, horror, edo period

items.title: Chrysanthemum and Horsefly, from an untitled series of Large Flowers
items.description_narrative: This color woodblock print by Katsushika Hokusai depicts a vibrant chrysanthemum blossom, its intricate petals rendered with delicate detail. A solitary horsefly hovers near the flower, adding a naturalistic element to the composition.
items.tags: chrysanthemum, horsefly, ukiyo-e, japanese art, woodblock print, nature, floral, edo period

items.title: Hamamatsu, from the series "Fifty-three Stations of the Tokaido (Tokaido gojusan tsugi)," also known as the Tokaido with Poem (Kyoka iri Tokaido)
items.description_narrative: Utagawa Hiroshige's color woodblock print, 'Hamamatsu,' captures a scene from the historic Tokaido Road, a vital route connecting Edo and Kyoto during Japan's Edo period. This work is part of his renowned 'Fifty-three Stations of the Tokaido' series, known for its depictions of landscapes and daily life along the famous highway.
items.tags: japanese landscape, ukiyo-e, woodblock print, tokaido road, historical travel, hamamatsu, edo period
